_comment: Regression floors/ceilings enforced by `python -m eval.run --gate`. A gated metric missing from a suite that ran fails the gate. Splits: dev (used while writing prompts), validation (h01-h22, written as held-out but re-run between fixes), heldout (s01-s24, sealed: written after the last prompt change). Offline values are the measured results of the deterministic policy (CI gate; it is extractive and answers in English, so non-English items fail language match). The openai floors for dev, validation and the judge come from the measured model runs, a little below them because a model run varies by one or two items. The openai floor for heldout (0.80) was fixed before the sealed items were ever run against the model and is not raised to match the result. Golden metrics are gated over every run of --repeat N (ADR-0019): floor met by the mean and no run more than one item below it; ceilings met by every run. Critic calibration (critic.*): a development set, tuned on; offline only the number check catches defects. Retrieval heldout (rh01-rh36): written after the glossary, which was not edited for them; its floors are the measured values (ADR-0020).
